org.primer.llm.usage: Tier-1 opacity primitive scale. Has no design meaning of its own, only its position in the ramp — consumed exclusively through tier-2 semantic aliases (theme.*). Do not read one of these directly from component code. 0.40/0.80 are the two steps the contrast axis switches between (theme.opacity.disabled) — 0.80 (opacity.80) was added specifically for the contrast="more" fix.
